LESSON: ATTENTIVE LISTENING

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ARABIC LANGUAGE
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.5: Attentive Listening
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Attentive Listening, part of Listening and Speaking in Grade 5 ARABIC LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: How do you spend your free time?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen attentively to an audio recording about hobbies and interests,

2. work collaboratively to pick out specific hobbies mentioned in the recording,

3. take turns to talk about their personal hobbies and interests (Begin; in my free time I like....),

4. work jointly to role play their hobbies and interests,

5. peer review each other’s presentation for constructive feedback.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen attentively to an audio recording about hobbies and interests,
2. work collaboratively to pick out specific hobbies mentioned in the recording,
3. take turns to talk about their personal hobbies and interests (Begin; in my free time I like....),
4. work jointly to role play their hobbies and interests,
5. peer review each other’s presentation for constructive feedback.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Attentive Listening together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: This is promoted as the learner contributes engagingly to the discussion as they take

turns to talk about their personal hobbies and interests.

• Creativity and imagination: This is enhanced as the learner embraces creative ideas when roleplaying their hobbies and

interests.

10

Values:
• Integrity: This is promoted as the learner accommodates diverse opinions when peer reviewing other’s presentation for

constructive feedback.

• Unity: This is promoted as the learner cooperates with peers to pick out specific hobbies mentioned in the recording.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Self-awareness: This is promoted as learner appreciates what others are able to do as hobbies and interests during their

discussions and role plays.

Link to Other Learning Areas:

The learner is able to relate the concept of hobbies and interests to their learning of various uses of leisure time as taught in

Religious Studies.
